provenance.method: AI-assisted Mongolian meanings from independent Japanese dictionary lookups (kotobank デジタル大辞泉/精選版日本国語大辞典/普及版字通; kanjipedia 角川新字源 改訂新版; goo国語辞書; jitenon; Weblio古語) retrieved 2026-10-10. Scope: entries WITHOUT source conflicts only. The 10 source-warned entries are deliberately EXCLUDED — conflicted senses stay visibly release-blocking (empty/unchanged mn + source_issue) until directly verifiable authoritative independent evidence for the exact spelling, reading AND sense is recorded with source/version/URL and reviewed by a human; findings for those entries live in docs/audits/2026-10-10-meaning-evidence.json only. Japanese spellings/readings and English source strings preserved unchanged. Two included entries (何々/どれどれ, 弾き応え) carry PARTIAL evidence (composition + retained gloss) and are marked for human review. reviewStatus: unreviewed.
